name: com.splattervault.sdk
description: Official Unity SDK for SplatterVault. Game clients: player sign-in and accounts (Meta Quest, Steam, Xsolla, PlayFab, Supabase, email, guests), player data and the store, with no API key. Servers and tools: create, manage and monitor dedicated game servers, with Master Server Toolkit integration.

samples.description: Game client: guest and SplatterVault email sign-in, add an email to a guest, sign out, delete the account. No API key.
Game client: save and load the player's settings with versions (ifVersion), a counter with inc, and the game's public data (ETag). No API key.
Game client: catalog, balances and items, buying with virtual currency, using items up, history, and finishing interrupted purchases. No API key.
Game client: Meta Quest sign-in and add-on purchases (define SV_META_PLATFORM), Steam sign-in (Steamworks.NET: STEAMWORKS_NET or SV_STEAMWORKS). Builds without those SDKs. No API key.
Server-side session management: SimpleSessionManager and TournamentManager (Editor and dedicated server builds only; API key from an environment variable)
Server-side spawner for a Master Server Toolkit master server: starts or claims SplatterVault servers that register their own rooms (Editor and dedicated server builds only)
